title: Smoke 13 - Multi Card Indicators
description: Emits 3 cards one each at info/warning/critical.
cqlContent:
library "Smoke13Multi" version '1.0.0'

using FHIR version '4.0.1'

context Patient

define "InfoCard":
  Tuple {
    summary: 'Info card',
    detail: 'info indicator',
    indicator: 'info',
    sourceLabel: 'Smoke 13'
  }

define "WarningCard":
  Tuple {
    summary: 'Warning card',
    detail: 'warning indicator',
    indicator: 'warning',
    sourceLabel: 'Smoke 13'
  }

define "CriticalCard":
  Tuple {
    summary: 'Critical card',
    detail: 'critical indicator',
    indicator: 'critical',
    sourceLabel: 'Smoke 13'
  }
